decisions.statement: MusicBrainz and LRCLIB are asked at the pace their clients keep.
An artist is named by a name or by a MusicBrainz id.
An artist MusicBrainz files no work under is read from their recordings.
A song already brought in keeps the slug that song was filed under.
A field this command does not fetch is left as that field was.
The words of a song land in a file beside the song.
A song LRCLIB answers nothing for is brought in without words.
The artist and the songs land as a single commit or do not land.
A page is written through the change working out what kind of path it is.
The landing a page goes through is handed in.
No test here reaches MusicBrainz or LRCLIB.
A run that wrote before it threw says in its refusal what that run had written.
A fault carries the code that fault names and says where it was thrown.
A words file already holding the words read is written again by nothing.
A song already filed under this artist with this title is filled in rather than filed twice.
An artist found by name whose titles meet no track already filed under that artist is refused.
An artist named by a MusicBrainz id is brought in whatever the titles meet.

definition: the command bringing an artist and every song of theirs in from MusicBrainz
